1.w: The one loving discipline is loving knowledge, and the one hating correction [is] stupid.

2.w: A good one brings forth favor from YHWH, and a man of schemes He will condemn.

3.w: A man is not established by wickedness, and the root of the righteous shall not be shaken.

4.w: A woman of virtue [is] a crown to her husband, and the one causing shame [is] like rottenness in his bones.

5.w: The thoughts of the righteous ones [are] justice; the counsels of the wicked ones [are for] deceit.

6.w: The words of the wicked ones lie in wait [for] blood, and the mouth of the upright ones delivers them.

7.w: Wicked ones are overthrown, and they are no more, and the house of the righteous ones shall stand.

8.w: A man is praised according to the mouth of his insight, and the one crooked of heart will be for contempt.

9.w: Better to be lightly esteemed, and a servant [is] unto him, than the one honoring himself and lacking bread.

10.w: A righteous one regards the life of his animal, and the mercies of the wicked ones [are] cruel.

11.w: The one working his land is satisfied [with] bread, while the one pursuing vanities [is] lacking of heart.

12.w: The wicked desires the net of evildoers, and the root of the righteous ones will give.

13.w: The snare of a wicked one [is] in the transgression of lips, and a righteous one will come out from distress.

14.w: From the fruit of the mouth, a man will be satisfied with good, and the recompence of the hands of a man returns to him.

15.w: The way of a fool [is] right in his own eyes, and the one listening to counsel [is] wise.

16.w: The fool—in a day his anger is known; and a prudent one covers shame.

17.w: The one breathing forth truth declares righteousness, and a witness of falsehoods, deceit.

18.w: There is one speaking rashly like the thrusts of a sword, and the tongue of the wise ones [is] healing.

19.w: The lip of truth is established forever, and the tongue of deceit for an instant.

20.w: Deception [is] in the heart of those devising evil, and for those counseling peace [is] joy.

21.w: Not any iniquity will meet with the righteous one, and the wicked are full of evil.

22.w: An abomination to YHWH [are] lips of falsehood, and those acting [in] truth [are] His delight.

23.w: A prudent man is concealing knowledge, and the heart of stupid ones calls out folly.

24.w: The hand of the diligent ones will rule, and slothfulness will be [put] to forced labor.

25.w: Anxiety in the heart of man bends [him] down, and a good word gladdens it.

26.w: A righteous one searches out from his neighbor, and the way of the wicked leads them astray.

27.w: The slothful one does not roast his game, and the wealth of a man [is] precious for a diligent one.

28.w: In the path of righteousness [is] life, and in [its] pathway [is] no death.
